reviewed_guards.observation: Preflight binds the initial Project inventory, exact validated pair set, canonical discovery, source/snapshot hashes, current signed report and retained coefficient rows. Apply requires all validated pairs plus the explicit review handoff. MC methods and existing finite coefficients are excluded from cached adoption.

Ordinary executed methods require ready constructor identity, actual saved pre-method runtime and group agreement. The exception is narrowly pinned to two successful California method bytes, their surviving failed constructor and exact completed-runtime digest. The later verification remains separately typed and original execution identity/constructor bytes are preserved. Current adoption context is stored separately.

reviewed_guards.area: Constructor reference promotion and retry caching
reviewed_guards.observation: Method evidence, constructor evidence and retrospective verification evidence are independently integrity checked, prefixed and promoted. Shared paths are deduplicated only when SHA agrees. The evidence_path variable no longer shadows the workbook path. EE-floor retry packages retain all per-method constructor and verification references. Reviewed shared hashes match reviewer_handoff.json.

Protected projections check retained finite/MC coefficients, arithmetic, diagnostics, independent inputs, groups, matching and selection. Existing model-local evidence bytes are immutable. Invalid historical provenance may receive an explicit retained-result trace but not an invented execution identity. Generated central metadata is compared before the one authorized review amendment.

One central lock and outer transaction enclose scoped model output adoption, saved-data Project/page build and later Humboldt promotion. Scoped workbooks, source workbooks, snapshots, manifests and generated evidence are backed up. Additional report, historical source and pre-registration Project writes are journaled. A later gate failure restores owned writes while preserving concurrent author edits as explicit conflicts.

The handoff and QA hashes are checked; signer/date, validated verdict, parser fields outside GE/TE and exact exclusions must remain intact. Historical original collisions reject. Internal registration reuses the outer lock. The review-only page gate reconstructs the exact bounded registration and compares all decompressed Project ZIP parts before requiring both pages to match the preceding Project fingerprint. There is no full-build fallback after a failed bounded gate.

limitations_already_disclosed_and_preser: The two California retrospective verifications authenticate saved runtime state, not the original successful constructor event or original adapter import-time identity. Source-custody authentication is an explicit coordinator prerequisite; this source review does not replace it.

The existing ordinary numerical and diagnostic restrictions, including true formulation unavailability and Humboldt failed/flagged outcomes, must remain visible. Source review is not scientific approval.

The 172 same-runtime numeric comparisons do not establish equivalence for all twenty deterministic branches. Humboldt's EE-floor configuration effect is a separate comparison and must be reported separately.
Rollback deliberately cannot overwrite a detected concurrent author change; such a conflict remains an explicit failure requiring reconciliation, not successful publication.
